name: Hitotsu Yane no Shita na no ni
original_name: ひとつ屋根の下なのに
source:
The Kirisaka family has three siblings: the caring oldest (Sora), her foul-mouthed twin brother (Rihito), and the youngest sibling who has to deal with all the fights between the two (Manami). While sometimes it was a little turbulent, they lived a peaceful life.
Until one day in May, a letter came from their mother…

[From [url=https://shinzoutranslations.com/en/releases/under-the-same-roof/]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
translation:
桐坂家有三个孩子：体贴的长姐空、嘴巴不饶人的双胞胎弟弟理人，以及总得应付两人争吵的幺妹真奈美。虽然偶有波澜，他们仍过着平静的生活。
直到五月的某一天，一封母亲寄来的信到了…

[摘自[url=https://shinzoutranslations.com/en/releases/under-the-same-roof/]Shinzou Translations[/url]]
